Yep. Happening on Live, and 1130 open beta. Only way to solve issue is restart VRChat.
People are confusing this for the old "Unity audio bug", but that bug made it so you couldn't hear anyone.
Interesting, this seems to be related to whole instances and not single users, I'm currently in a world with friends and we never had that bug before but now all of us got it.

I've been having this issue very recently too with Reimajo's VRPiano prefab I had in my world. When it's played by other people, it starts to throw audio in weird directions and causes their voices to be heard in one ear only. It however fixes itself when the Piano is played again.
On some occasions, it also causes the world audio to overlap each other when the bug occurs. I'm not sure how any of this happens, but I can easily tell that it's because of different audio sources played at the same exact time.
I've had this issue on Quest, so I am not too sure if it is directly related to avatar audio.
Bumping, still an issue. Had 20+ players in a lobby and bug occurred with avatars with high amounts of audio sources.

This bug has existed for years at this point.  It got briefly fixed and then reverted by a hotfix like a week later and never touched again.  The actual cause is something in the audio code bugging out so it can't keep up with where audio sources are meant to come from.  I don't have the exact error message of it in my latest VRChat logs, but you can see a recurring audio engine error plain as day repeating through your logfile once it happens in-game. 
(Hence why changing worlds solves nothing;  The problems fundamentally in the client code itself)
We've made a variety of fixes to this issue in 2022.1.2. Please post if you run into the issue again after updating to 2022.1.2 and we'll reopen this.

details:
For a few weeks now since a recent patch around May. Our RP group as well as others have been experiencing issues where the sound engine seems to crash or break and suddenly people can be heard no matter where in the world they are and the directions are incorrect as well. 
I've been trying to discover the potential cause for awhile now. Here are some things I've narrowed it down to.
- Despite the worlds or models not changing the bug suddenly started existing after a recent patch.
- The issue seems to trigger when someone switches avatars in spawn. But doesn't effect everyone at once but a large majority.
- Triggering sounds in the world might be a cause as well as some people have noted this is when it happened for them. I use VRC_Trigger / AudioTrigger for most sounds but some are Game Objects that Play the audio source on Awake.
- Reproducing by performing a specific action doesn't seem to be the case. It's rather random. Happens to random people at random times. But usually after at least 20 minutes into the lobby.
- The issue seems to happen more often when the world has a high population, we usually avg 40-60 players a session. 
- Removing Audio override zones doesn't fix the issue. 
- My theory is it has to do with initialization of an avatar with Sounds/Spatial Audio Component. All Avatars used for enemies are made using the suggested method of enabling Audio Components instead of the game object.
Below are links to the worlds we use, but the bug isn't limited to these worlds. It has happened to several RPers/Players in many other worlds. The worlds linked also have Avatar pedastals for about 100 or so avatars. Many of which have attacks/sounds etc. I'll try to get Twitch Clips of it happening to players from multiple angles but due to randomness of it might not help. I'll attempt copying my log files next session I happens in.
